Translation verse contains the full text of OSMAIN v12 ('You turned my mourning into dancing...'). However, based on standard Hebrew numbering (WLC), this is often split or followed by additional content in other versions. In this specific comparison, WLC v12 matches OSMAIN v12 exactly in terms of the provided text segments.
This verse contains content not present in the provided OSMAIN list (which ends at v12). The text 'That my glory may sing your praise...' is missing from the Norwegian master text provided.

extraContent.description: Text: 'לְמַעַן יְזַמֶרְךָ כָבֹוד וְלֹא יִדּם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לְעֹולָם אֹודֶךָּ' (That my glory may sing your praise and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever). This verse is present in the WLC translation but missing from the provided OSMAIN text.
